label: Whatever has represented esse equal to its essence has the exercise of its esse in its nature
paraphrase: OPEN (exercise in the nature), analyst formulation: for every being x whose represented esse equals its represented essence (EXISTENCE_IN_ESSENCE_3, act identity, ESSENCE_3 maps), it lies in the nature of x (ESSENCE_5) that x's act of being is exercised, unconditionally: the proposition true exactly at the points where that act is exercised. The substantive half of the unconditional bridge 565ccd6c: act identity alone does not give it (controls, conditionalIdentity: identity with only the conditional exercise in the nature, and the being contingent). Existence-conditional essentialism rejects it, given the act-fact link, for any identity being whose absence is representable (controls, law 6).
